hadith:
Ablutions (Wudu') - Narrated Maimuna:

The Prophet (ﷺ) ate (a piece of) mutton from the shoulder region and then prayed without repeating the ablution.
message: Uphold the faith without division, as Allah commands, and turn to Him in supplication, trusting that He hears and responds—even if not always in the way or timing you hope. The Prophet ﷺ ate mutton and prayed without renewing wudu, reminding us to follow his example in matters of worship.
name:
Al Mujeeb - الْمُجِيبُ - The Responsive

Al Mujeeb describes Allah responding to those who call upon Him. Quran 11:61 pairs responsiveness with nearness. The name expresses His hearing and answering of supplication, without promising that every request is granted in the form or at the time a person chooses.
verse:
Ash-Shuraa - The Consultation - 42:13

He has ordained for you ˹believers˺ the Way which He decreed for Noah, and what We have revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺ and what We decreed for Abraham, Moses, and Jesus, ˹commanding:˺ “Uphold the faith, and make no divisions in it.” What you call the polytheists to is unbearable for them. Allah chooses for Himself whoever He wills, and guides to Himself whoever turns ˹to Him˺.
